decision: Full car = 'Blobeye Full Car.stl' (2023-07, 23.0M tris, Drive 1-4YmtPLhY5WR5MOA4Rj5O193MN3cgQsC), decimated 4 mm (3.11M tris)
why: Brief's suggested car; densest full scan (Low Poly versions are 2.3M tris). Clean capture: no ground, wheels with spokes and calipers scanned

decision: Canonical frame = Drive 'Front bumper/Aligned for Splitter' frame (car axis-aligned: X width, Y length nose at low Y, Z up); hi-res car moved into it by FPFH+RANSAC+ICP onto 'Blobeye Full Car (Low Poly)' in that folder (p50 1.38 mm, 93% <3 mm); then ive prep (mm->m, centred, floor) -> car4.json; every part prepped --like car4.json
why: The raw car was yawed ~30 deg; the aligned folder already has a level, nose-forward frame (tyre contacts within 2 cm front/rear), so no hand-made levelling transform. One prep transform for all states (lesson: never re-normalise)

decision: Front-end states (all assembled / hood removed / bumper removed / all removed / tabs) share one Artec frame: moved to the car with all_removed->all_removed_1 (0.75 mm) then ONE ICP correction fitted on the hood/fender area only (hood_removed's, 3.6 deg/61 mm), giving 1.8-2.1 mm on all four
why: Bumper area differs between sessions (state scans' bumper/lip is 12-26 mm off the 2023 car's), so fitting on it biased ICP; per-scan fits disagreed, the shared one fits every state (cross-check table in the session)

decision: Separate 'Blobeye Bumper (For Splitter)' part scan NOT used; the front bumper panel is carved from the full car itself (car tris in the bumper box >12 mm from 'bumper removed', largest island only)
why: Part scan is a different bumper/session (p50 6-12 mm off the car's bumper; overlay shows it sitting low and forward). Carving keeps the exploded bumper identical to the car's bumper, so it seats exactly on reassembly

decision: Hood, rear wing and left side skirt carved from the full car the same way (vs 'hood removed'+'GD Scan Engine Bay', 'Rear Wing data' (= wing-off rear, 1.7 mm), 'Sideskirt removed' (2.1 mm)); openings filled with those state scans as captured, each only inside its own box (tools/fill.py) -> base_open
why: Lessons: carve the smallest zone, use state scans as captured over the trimmed car. Per-fill boxes stop e.g. the engine-bay session's different lip leaking into the bumper zone. Contact sheets: chk/bo.jpg shows engine bay, front-mount intercooler and crash structure, filled sill and trunk

decision: GD Scan Engine Bay registered with FPFH+RANSAC onto car front + front states (3/6 tries same pose, fitness 0.24 -> refined p50 1.6 mm; fenders z-fight in the overlay)
why: Only scan with the full engine bay (the front states caught just the radiator support); it is what the hood opening reveals

decision: Not used: GD Sideskirt part (carved skin instead, same reason as bumper), GD Scan Hood (small 30x43 cm hood-scoop fragment), oil cooler/pancake duct/print files/04-05 game model
why: Brief: only our scan data, no CAD/game assets; carved panels guarantee exact seating
